correctness.rationale: The ten-interval coloring is explicit. Inclusion-exclusion gives the exact rectangle-under-a-diagonal area formula, whose interval-triple sum is 553/1000 after normalization. The finite coloring counts form a Riemann sum with only finitely many line discontinuities, so the asymptotic density follows. Exact arithmetic and finite enumeration independently agree with the stated value.

originality.rationale: The inspected current primary source arXiv:2609.18474v1 states 10/21 as the k=4 specialization of its general lower bound, calls its k>=4 bounds the first nontrivial ones to the authors' knowledge, and explicitly identifies k=4 as worth further investigation. The earlier Parczyk-Spiegel multiplicity paper treats k=3. Searches over equivalent four-color and anti-Ramsey formulations, exact densities, and the breakpoint data did not identify the 553/1000 construction or a stronger four-color lower bound. The recency of the motivating preprint leaves residual risk from unindexed contemporaneous work.

value.rationale: The bound improves the stated four-color lower bound from 10/21 to 553/1000, an absolute gain of 1613/21000 about 0.07681, in exactly the k=4 case singled out by the recent source. The construction is deterministic and its limiting density has a compact exact certificate.
